---
title: "Declaration on the use of artificial intelligence"
lang: en
---

This programme studies the use of language models in legal research, and coherence
requires declaring how they are used in producing this site.

## In producing this site

Structure, drafting and revision are assisted by a language model, under full review
by the responsible researcher, who answers for all published content. No text is
published without complete human reading.

Model, version and purpose are stated at the foot of any page produced with material
assistance.

## In the research itself

Published work declares, in each case, the model used, the pinned version, execution
parameters and date. That declaration is a condition of
replicability, and its absence in the work of others is an object of criticism in this
programme.

## What is not done

No reference, citation, judicial decision, statutory provision or figure is produced
by automatic generation without verification against the primary source. Every discrepancy found on verification is
declared in the text itself, including where it corrects my own earlier work.

## Third-party data

No client data, case filings or information under professional secrecy is used,
processed or referred to in this research programme, under any circumstances, pursuant
to article 7, II, of Brazilian Federal Law 8.906/1994.
